request.title: Fix add() in src/calc.js to add instead of subtract
request.scope:
Project: calc-symlink (git branch main, HEAD d893400 "calc with a symlink", no uncommitted changes).

The bug: src/calc.js line 2 defines `export function add(a, b) { return a - b; }`. It subtracts, so the test `add adds` in test/calc.test.js (`assert.equal(add(2, 3), 5)`) fails.

Change: edit src/calc.js so add returns `a + b`. Keep the function signature and export name unchanged.

Side effect to leave alone: `average(values)` in the same file (lines 5-9) sums values by calling `add(sum, v)`. Fixing add fixes average as well. Its existing test `average of three numbers` (`average([1, 2, 3])` equals 2) should then pass without editing average.

Expected end state: `npm test` (node --test) runs both tests in test/calc.test.js and both pass.

Files found: src/calc.js (the bug), test/calc.test.js (tests, not to be edited), package.json (`"type": "module"`, `"test": "node --test"`), README.md (one-line description, no change needed), pkg-link.json (reads identically to package.json; likely a symlink to it, given the commit title "calc with a symlink". Assumption: it is a symlink. Not verified with a shell because only reads were allowed).

Assumption: the requester's wording "Fix add() ... so it adds" means the intended behaviour is ordinary numeric addition of a and b, as the test expects.
acceptanceChecks: src/calc.js contains `export function add(a, b)` whose body returns `a + b`, and no subtraction remains in add().
`export function average` in src/calc.js is unchanged from the original (still loops with `sum = add(sum, v)` and divides by values.length).
`npm test` exits with code 0 and its output shows both tests `add adds` and `average of three numbers` as passing, with 0 failures.
`git diff --stat` shows only src/calc.js changed (test/, package.json, README.md, and pkg-link.json untouched).
pkg-link.json still points to the same target as before (if it is a symlink, `ls -l pkg-link.json` shows the same link target as at commit d893400).
request.originalRequest: Fix add() in src/calc.js so it adds, make npm test pass
request.context: Project folder: calc-symlink. Git: branch main at d893400; 0 changed and 0 new file(s) not yet committed. Tracked files: 5. Top level: README.md, package.json, pkg-link.json, src, test.
constraints: Change only the body of add() in src/calc.js. Do not change average(), the exports, or the function signature.
Do not edit test/calc.test.js or change the expected values in the tests.
Do not edit package.json, README.md, or pkg-link.json. Do not replace, delete, or re-create the symlink pkg-link.json if it is one.
Do not add new dependencies, scripts, or files.
Do not add extra validation or type coercion to add() beyond the request.
setupSteps: Run `npm install` in the project folder (tig detected this). package.json declares no dependencies and there is no lockfile, so this is expected to finish quickly and do nothing. Assumption: no install is needed, and this step is optional.
Requires Node.js 18 or later, because `node --test` is the built-in test runner. Assumption: the worker's Node version meets this; check with `node --version`.
testSteps: Run `npm test` in the project folder. Expected: node's test runner reports the two tests in test/calc.test.js as passing and exits with code 0.
Run `git diff` and confirm the only change is the `add` body in src/calc.js (`a - b` becomes `a + b`).
Optionally run `ls -l pkg-link.json` and confirm it is still a symlink with the same target as before the change.
